gripOrHq.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

gripOrHq.title: Forgotten Backup Chip
gripOrHq.rulesText: Search your trash for a program and bring it into your hand.

gripOrHq.title: Finders Keepers
gripOrHq.rulesText: Roll three dice. Gain that many bits.

heapOrArchives.title: Sneak Preview
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Choose a program from your trash or search your stack for a program. Install that program, at no cost. Shuffle your stack afterwards. At the end of the turn, take the program into your hand.

heapOrArchives.title: Forgotten Backup Chip
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your trash for a program and bring it into your hand.

heapOrArchives.title: Airport Locker
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [5], [T]: Search your stack for a program, and install that program, if you can. Shuffle your stack afterwards. You may use this ability during an encounter with a piece of ice. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

heapOrArchives.title: Chiba Bank Account
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [1], [T]: Gain [4]. You may use this ability whenever you pay any cost or penalty. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

heapOrArchives.title: Rent-I-Con
heapOrArchives.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

heapOrArchives.title: Running Interference
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Make a run. During that run, the Corp must pay [X], in addition to the normal cost, to rez each piece of ice, where X is the rez cost of that piece of ice. Playing a double prep costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

heapOrArchives.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Sneak Preview
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Choose a program from your trash or search your stack for a program. Install that program, at no cost. Shuffle your stack afterwards. At the end of the turn, take the program into your hand.

scoreArea.title: Data Fort Remapping
scoreArea.rulesText: Put a Remap counter on Data Fort Remapping when you score it. Remap Counter: End a run.

scoreArea.title: Unlisted Research Lab
scoreArea.rulesText: Draw an additional card at the start of each of your turns.

rig.title: Invisibility
rig.rulesText: Put [1] from the bank on Invisibility when it is installed. Use this bit only to pay for using icebreakers during runs, but not for using noisy icebreakers. If you use the bit, replace it at the start of your next turn.

rig.title: Rent-I-Con
rig.rulesText: [1]: Break ice subroutine. At the end of this run, trash Rent-I-Con. [1]: +1 strength

rig.title: Elena Laskova
rig.rulesText: Whenever you play a prep, gain an additional [1] the first time you gain bits from its effect. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

rig.title: The Shell Traders
rig.rulesText: A: Choose a program or hardware card from your hand. Set that card aside face up, and put a number of Shell counters on it equal to its installation cost. When the last Shell counter on that card has been removed, install that card, at no cost. Remove one Shell counter from one card at the start of each of your turns. [1]: Remove one Shell counter from a card.

rig.title: Swiss Bank Account
rig.rulesText: You may use the following abilities whenever you pay any cost or penalty. [T]: Gain [2]. [3], [T]: Gain [6]. Hidden resources are installed face down, but are put into the trash face up.

rig.title: Junkyard BBS
rig.rulesText: A, [1]: Bring the top card from your trash into your hand.

rig.title: The Shell Traders
rig.rulesText: A: Choose a program or hardware card from your hand. Set that card aside face up, and put a number of Shell counters on it equal to its installation cost. When the last Shell counter on that card has been removed, install that card, at no cost. Remove one Shell counter from one card at the start of each of your turns. [1]: Remove one Shell counter from a card.

ice.title: Entrapment
ice.rulesText: *If you pay [2], Runner is now encountering the outermost piece of rezzed ice on a data fort of your choice, instead of passing Entrapment. The run is now considered to be a run on that data fort. If there is no rezzed ice on that fort, Runner is considered to have passed the last piece of ice on that fort.

ice.title: Vortex
ice.rulesText: *If you pay [2], Runner is now encountering the outermost piece of rezzed ice on a data fort of your choice, instead of passing Vortex. The run is now considered to be a run on that data fort. If there is no rezzed ice on that fort, Runner is considered to have passed the last piece of ice on that fort.

ice.title: Deadeye
ice.rulesText: *Trash a program. *End the run. If Runner has used a noisy icebreaker during this run, the cost to rez Deadeye is reduced by [5].

root.title: Self-Destruct
root.rulesText: Install Self-Destruct only in a subsidiary data fort. [T]. Trash all other cards installed in or on this data fort. Do 1 Net damage for each card successfully trashed in this way. Use this ability only when Runner accesses Self-Destruct.

root.title: Satellite Monitors
root.rulesText: At the start of each of your turns, you may roll a die for each run Runner made during his or her last turn. For each 1, give Runner a tag.

ice.title: Baskerville
ice.rulesText: *Do 2 Net damage. *Trace5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a Baskerville counter. Each counter does 2 Net damage at the start of each run. Runner may remove a Baskerville counter by taking an action to spend [3]. *End the run. If Runner has used a noisy icebreaker during this run, the cost to rez Baskerville is reduced by [5].

encounteredIce.title: Baskerville
encounteredIce.rulesText: *Do 2 Net damage. *Trace5 - If trace is successful, give Runner a Baskerville counter. Each counter does 2 Net damage at the start of each run. Runner may remove a Baskerville counter by taking an action to spend [3]. *End the run. If Runner has used a noisy icebreaker during this run, the cost to rez Baskerville is reduced by [5].
